purpose: Defines the document system of the project: which document kinds exist, how they are identified, placed and referenced, to prevent duplicated content, ID collisions and unfindable documents.
summary: Overview: purpose of defining a document system and the problems it prevents
Target system nature: internal documentation operation of the forge plugin and project
Premise: document IDs allocated by the next-spec-id skill
FNC-001: document identifier as PREFIX-NNN with global numbering
FNC-001: different prefixes use separate number sequences
FNC-002: cross-component specs identified and placed without belonging to one component
FNC-003: new document IDs are allocated via skill, never manually, to avoid branch collisions
tasks: Creating a new requirements, design or ADR document
